name: som-the-office-cat
description: A pixel office cat in a pane beside the chat that acts out what Claude is doing, with live context, usage-limit and cost statistics underneath

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane's text: en (English, the default) or th (ภาษาไทย)

warnAt.title: Amber at %
warnAt.description: Context, usage-limit or spend % at which a figure turns amber (empty = 70)

alarmAt.title: Red at %
alarmAt.description: % at which a figure turns red, and the cat sweats when context reaches it (empty = 85)

catAlarm.title: Cat alarm
catAlarm.description: Som looks alarmed when context is nearly full

showCategories.title: Show context categories
showCategories.description: One row per context category under the bar

showSessionCost.title: Show session cost
showSessionCost.description: What the session has cost at API prices

showMonthlySpend.title: Show monthly spend
showMonthlySpend.description: Extra-usage spend against its cap; off means the usage endpoint is never asked
